projects.title: Web-Based Church Management System
projects.context: Archdiocese of Kota Kinabalu · Final Year Project
projects.summary: A web-based management system that centralises church information, digital bulletins, announcements, sacramental services, donation management and catechesis for the 23 churches in Kota Kinabalu.
projects.problem: Church information, bulletins, announcements and services across the 23 churches in Kota Kinabalu needed a single, central web platform.
projects.approach: Following the Waterfall methodology, the project covers system analysis, database design, implementation and software testing, with three distinct user roles.
projects.outcome: Currently in development as my Final Year Project.
projects.privacyNote: Screenshots use sample data only. No real parishioner records, credentials or internal church information are shown.
